messages:
maria: Heads-up — support reported tenant routing skipping X-Redwood-Env header for some requests to /v1/generate. Happens intermittently.
chris: example request?
maria: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "X-Redwood-Env: tenant-alpha" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
maria: They see traffic land on the default pool instead of tenant-alpha's pool.
priya: Do we have any rewrite rules or header whitelist on the gateway? Some CDNs strip custom headers by default.
julian: we do normalize headers and have a whitelist for external ingress. But internal routing uses auth claims for tenant. If auth fallback fails we use header override.
chris: hmm order of precedence: JWT tenant claim > X-Redwood-Env header > default. Is that documented? Might be reversed in code.
priya: I can repro locally. Looks like nginx ingress was dropping headers when proxy_set_header wasn't used in the canary rules.
priya: patch suggestion:

```
route_match:
  path: /v1/*
  headers:
    X-Redwood-Env: present
overrides:
  header_preserve: true
```

(not exact yaml)
infra-bot: deploy 1774005160: ingresses/canary updated by priya
maria: @priya nice. Can we also make header matching case-insensitive? Some clients send x-redwood-env.
priya: nginx already lowercases keys, but our router's header matcher was strict. will push fix to accept lower/upper.
chris: we should also add telemetry: emit a metric when header-based match is used vs jwt-based. That'll help SREs.
julian: agree — add tag routing.alt_source=header|jwt in spans.
maria: one more gotcha: auth proxy sets X-Auth-User which we use for impersonation. Make sure we don't accidentally trust forwarded headers from public ingress without signature.
priya: plan: (1) fix header matcher to be case-insensitive and whitelist-preserve, (2) add metric for routing source, (3) add note in docs about precedence and CDN header stripping. I'll open a PR.
chris: add a unit test for header precedence + integration test with ingress config.
priya: will do. assigning to self. thanks :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all — update thread when PR is up.
